title: Answer: information is physically encoded structure, of which finite observers recover a fraction

statements.text: Information is physically encoded structure and is never detached from physics: encoding, erasure, distinguishability and recovery are all physically constrained. Finite observers have finite distinguishability and reach only part of it, and recoverability $R = I_{\mathrm{acc}} / I_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the fraction of the encoded structure they can reconstruct. The framework offers $R$ as a bookkeeping measure across regimes, not as a new entropy or a replacement for Shannon entropy.
statements.scope: the papers Recovering relativity from temporal continuity and The descendancy of physical law

sources.quote: As such, information is not detached from physics. Encoding, erasure, distinguishability, and recovery remain physically constrained.
Recoverability denotes the capacity of finite observers to reconstruct stable relational information from physically accessible sectors of an evolving system.
Information and Recoverability forms a boundary authority across all tiers.
